$comment: Migrations that a later baseline replaces. The pre-deploy marks each as applied (never runs it) once its supersededBy migration is applied, and only while migration.sql still has this sha256. Add an entry only after reviewing that the baseline creates everything the schema still uses from it.

migrations.name: 20260128062035_init_railway_production
migrations.reason: Initial schema of an earlier data model. 0_init creates User, IntelItem, MarketProposal, ProposalVote and UserMetrics; the other eight tables and its eight enums are not in prisma/schema.prisma. Running it fails with 42P07 (relation User already exists), which blocked every later migration (P3018, 13 Nov 2026).

migrations.name: 20260128192526_add_risk_level
migrations.reason: Adds RiskLevel to the table Market of the earlier data model. Neither Market nor the enum RiskLevel is in 0_init or prisma/schema.prisma. Running it fails with 42P01 (relation Market does not exist): the P3018 of 14 Nov 2026.

migrations.name: 20260131000000_add_auth_user
migrations.reason: Creates AuthUser and an earlier VerificationCode. 0_init already creates AuthUser, and 20260717000000_add_verification_code_table creates VerificationCode in its current shape. The two indexes only this migration makes (VerificationCode_userId_code_idx, VerificationCode_expiresAt_idx) are not in the schema. Running it fails with 42P07 (AuthUser already exists).

migrations.name: 20260131120000_phase2_3_4_init
migrations.reason: Custodial wallet tables of an earlier model: WalletAccount, Authenticator, the Wallet* enums and AuthUser.encryptedPrivateKey, encryptedMnemonic, walletSalt. None is in the schema (the custodial columns were removed on purpose, see 20261019150000). The Transaction and AddressBookEntry it touches are created by 0_init in their current shape. Running it fails with 42703 (column hash does not exist).

migrations.name: 20260523000000_hpf_product_passport
migrations.reason: Creates ProductPassport and ProvenanceEvent with their indexes and key; 0_init creates all eight objects. Running it fails with 42P07 (ProductPassport already exists).

migrations.name: 20260708000000_add_quest_social_airdrop_tables
migrations.reason: Creates the quest, social and airdrop tables with an aztecAddress column on QuestClaim and seeds two quests. 0_init creates these tables in their current shape, where QuestClaim is keyed by identityHash; the aztecAddress column and its two indexes are not in the schema. Running it fails with 42703 (column aztecAddress does not exist).
